prompt: Write my LCA comparison assignment. I have my research notes ready.

assertions.name: has_introduction_section
assertions.description: Draft contains a clearly marked Introduction or Abstract section

assertions.name: has_limitations_section
assertions.description: Draft contains a clearly marked Limitations section

assertions.name: has_apa_references_section
assertions.description: Draft ends with a References section containing APA-formatted entries with DOI links

assertions.name: uses_parenthetical_citations
assertions.description: Draft uses (Author, Year) parenthetical citation format, not footnotes

assertions.name: no_em_dashes
assertions.description: Draft text does not contain em dashes (—)

assertions.name: cites_poore_nemecek_2018
assertions.description: Draft cites Poore & Nemecek (2018) — the primary source present in research notes

assertions.name: mentions_tracker_update
assertions.description: Output mentions updating the university tracker or notes the tracker was updated
